description: Curated public GitHub repositories for InfraGraph parser regression and blast-radius testing. Clone into mvp_demo/public_repos/{id}/ before enabling subscriptions.

repos.description: Canonical Terragrunt live infrastructure layout spanning qa/stage/prod and multiple AWS accounts.
repos.why_good_for_testing: Exercises include blocks, find_in_parent_folders, dependency/mock_outputs, read_terragrunt_config, remote module source pins, and multi-environment folder hierarchies without synthetic fixtures.

repos.description: Companion Terraform modules (ASG, MySQL) consumed by the Gruntwork live example.
repos.why_good_for_testing: Demonstrates upstream module_source repos referenced by downstream terragrunt.hcl files via git:: URLs and version refs — the core blast-radius edge pattern InfraGraph must resolve.

repos.description: Industry-standard AWS VPC Terraform module with subnets, NAT, route tables, and flow logs.
repos.why_good_for_testing: Large multi-file module (main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, versions.tf) with data sources, nested resource graphs, and count/for_each patterns commonly referenced by live infra repos.

repos.description: AWS security group module with dynamic ingress/egress rule blocks and rule submodule.
repos.why_good_for_testing: Best-in-class coverage of nested HCL blocks (dynamic ingress/egress), computed rules, and submodule references — directly maps to security_scan_fields.sg_open_to_world parser tests.

repos.description: Complex EKS cluster module with nested submodules (node groups, IRSA, addons) and cross-resource dependencies.
repos.why_good_for_testing: Stress-tests deep module trees, provider aliases, depends_on chains, and submodule version pins — simulates enterprise module upgrade blast radius.

repos.description: Cloud Posse catalog of composable AWS Terraform/Terragrunt components (VPC, EKS, RDS, etc.).
repos.why_good_for_testing: Real-world component library with terragrunt.hcl per stack, remote-state patterns, and layered account/region/env folder structures used by platform teams.

repos.description: Binbash Leverage production-style layered AWS infrastructure using Terragrunt across accounts and regions.
repos.why_good_for_testing: End-to-end live infra repo with terragrunt dependency chains, mock_outputs, remote module sources (terraform-aws-modules), and multi-account layouts — closest to customer deployments.

repos.description: Google Cloud Foundation Fabric — modular Terraform for GCP networking, IAM, GKE, and data platforms.
repos.why_good_for_testing: Validates parser against non-AWS providers and multi-file module layouts (modules/, fast/, blueprints/) — catches provider-agnostic HCL parsing regressions.
